hypotheses.S1_fineweb_replication: On FineWeb high and random positives, known-category top-mode SAE-decoder mediation has median at least 0.30 and exceeds low-mode mediation by at least 0.20 in both bases.
hypotheses.S2_ood_positive_transfer: For eligible known categories on both WikiText-103 and TinyStories random positives, top-mode SAE-decoder mediation has median at least 0.25 and exceeds low modes by at least 0.15 in at least one basis.
hypotheses.S3_local_selectivity: Across corpora and positive strata, known top modes have median feature-coordinate change at least 2 times low modes and downstream effect energy at least 1.5 times low modes in both bases.
hypotheses.S4_positive_specificity: Across known categories, random-positive top-mode mediation exceeds hard-negative mediation by at least 0.10 in at least one basis.
hypotheses.S5_known_prospective_gap: Across eligible corpora and positive strata, known top-mode mediation exceeds prospective top-mode mediation by at least 0.10 in at least one basis.
hypotheses.S6_high_example_bias: Known random-positive mediation is no more than 0.15 below high-positive mediation in both bases, ruling out an effect confined to extreme examples.
